supportingSources.label: Kineticist Super Star and Big Star rules
Pinball Nirvana Super Star period flyer

strategy.summary: Hit the two upper outside targets and either lower outside slingshot to raise the three protective posts. Sweep either five-button side arc to raise the center-saucer value, knock down the target in front of the saucer, and collect the value before repeating.

quickInfo.name: Center-saucer value
quickInfo.summary: Each completed 1-through-5 side sequence raises the Super Star saucer by 5,000 to a 20,000 maximum.

quickInfo.name: Big Star value
quickInfo.summary: The Add-A-Ball Big Star sibling uses 10,000 advances and a 40,000 center-saucer maximum.

quickInfo.name: Saucer access
quickInfo.summary: The center drop target must fall before a clean shot can enter the scoring saucer behind it.

quickInfo.name: Side posts
quickInfo.summary: The upper outside target on each side raises that outlane post, while the middle target on the same side lowers it.

quickInfo.name: Center post
quickInfo.summary: Either lower outside slingshot raises the center post, but the rollover directly above it lowers the post.

steps.text: Use the opening bumper action to find both upper outside targets and raise the two outlane posts.
Let either lower outside slingshot raise the center post before forcing the main scoring line.
From a controlled flipper, shoot through one complete five-button side arc.
Repeat the safer side arc until the center-saucer value reaches the useful or maximum award.
Hit the center drop target to expose the saucer.
Shoot the open center saucer and collect the built value.
Re-raise any protection that the collect or an incidental switch lowered, then rebuild the saucer.

fallback.title: Protection-first upper play
fallback.when: Use this when the side-button sweep or center target sends unsafe returns.

steps.text: Hit the upper outside targets and either lower outside slingshot to raise as many protective posts as the current ball allows.
Send the ball through the safer upper gap instead of forcing the center target.
Take incidental red-button advances and SU-P-ER lane progress.
Return to the center collect only after the target and saucer feeds look repeatable.

alternatives.title: Early center collect
alternatives.when: Use this when the match needs a smaller safe award or the side sweeps are unreliable.

steps.text: Let either lower outside slingshot raise the center post.
Build one or two complete side sequences.
Knock down the center target and collect the current saucer value.
Rebuild protection before starting another cycle.
Hit both upper outside targets and either lower outside slingshot to raise the three posts.
Complete enough 1-through-5 side sweeps to maximize the saucer.
Hit the center target to lower it.
Collect 20,000 on Super Star or 40,000 on Big Star.
Restore protection and repeat.

techniques.name: Five-button side sweep
techniques.instruction: Aim through the complete red-button arc so one clean trip scores all five advances in order.

techniques.name: Post-state check
techniques.instruction: Check every post after a standup, sling, rollover, or saucer collect because each protector has a separate lowering switch.

cautions.issue: The two outlane posts can let a slow ball creep around them.
cautions.response: Keep tracking and nudging the ball legally; treat a raised post as help, not a guaranteed save.

cautions.issue: A center drain can roll over the down-post button before reaching the raised center post.
cautions.response: Keep both flippers ready for a deflection and do not rely on the center post alone.

cautions.issue: Shots other than the open center saucer can produce uncontrolled returns.
cautions.response: Restore protection after every unsafe rebound and collect a smaller saucer value when control is deteriorating.

strategy.simpleOverview: Super Star / Big Star uses three protective posts to support a repeating center-saucer collect. Hit the upper outside side targets and lower outside slings to raise the posts, complete either five-button side arc to raise the saucer value, knock down the center target, and shoot the exposed saucer.
strategy.overview: Super Star / Big Star uses three protective posts to support a repeating center-saucer collect. Hit the upper outside targets to raise the outlane posts and use either lower outside sling to raise the center post, then repeat the safer five-button arc until the saucer reaches a useful value. Hit the center target, collect the saucer, and restore any protection that the cycle lowered.
